## Why this matters for VibePromptRig specifically

<!--
We avoid feature creep aggressively. A feature is worth building if:
1. You hit the bug class 2+ times (or 2+ projects)
2. The fix can't be a one-off code change in your project
3. The pattern is reusable across multiple projects / customers

Make the case. If 1 of 3 is clear, that's enough. If 0 of 3, this is a
nice-to-have rather than a must-have.
-->
